contact_title: Director of Boarding and International Services
alt_email: Kierrin.Gaffney@scotscollege.school.nz (Assistant Director of Boarding); dominic.bird@scotscollege.school.nz (Director of Rugby); hr@scotscollege.school.nz (HR); enquiries@scotscollege.school.nz
gap_notes: Staff directory lists five current 'Gap Tutors' (e.g. Sebastian Turner, Emma Walsingham, Julian Stroh), so there is an established gap tutor programme. HR contact is hr@scotscollege.school.nz. Copy Director of Rugby Dominic Bird to push the rugby coaching angle.
rugby_notes: Wellington 1st XV Premiership regular (strong home record at Strathmore); national Top 4 runner-up 2015 (lost to Rotorua BHS). Weak 2025 season (lost 97-7 to Napier BHS). Has a Director of Rugby.
scenery_notes: Eastern Wellington (Miramar peninsula) near the south coast and harbour; city life, Interislander ferry to South Island (Picton/Marlborough Sounds), coastal walks.
notes: Strongest gap-tutor fit in region: active gap tutor cohort plus a Director of Rugby. Contacts directory also lists Boarding Managers Gerald Yang and Rachel More.

gap_notes: Boarding 'Our Team' page lists two current Gap Assistants from England (Luke Flexman, Hamish Turner). Recruits UK gappies every year.
rugby_notes: Wellington 1st XV Premiership champions 2024 and 2025 (unbeaten in 2025, 9th title). Reached the national Top 4 in 2026 (reported 3rd/4th). Probably the strongest rugby school in the Wellington region.
scenery_notes: Hutt Valley below the Remutaka and Tararua ranges; mountain biking and tramping; 30 min to Wellington harbour and the Interislander ferry.
notes: Top target: elite rugby plus proven UK gap assistant intake. Director of Boarding email is also given on the Our People page; the boarding welcome page gives boarding@.

gender: boys (partners with St Matthew's Collegiate as Trinity Schools; senior classes shared)
boarding_houses: Cranleigh, Repton, Rugby (Year 9s start in Rugby House)
contact_title: Director of Boarding (also Housemaster, Cranleigh House)
alt_email: jbb@rathkeale.school.nz (Jesse Bird, Housemaster Repton); pjr@rathkeale.school.nz (Phil Roach, Housemaster Rugby House); office@rathkeale.school.nz
gap_notes: Boarding pages mention live-in housemasters, matrons and tutors. No page names gap tutors explicitly, but it is a classic rural Anglican boarding school of the type that takes UK gappies. Worth asking.
rugby_notes: Plays in the Wellington 1st XV Premiership (2025 fixtures against Scots and St Pat's Silverstream) and has Central North Island links. Strong rural rugby culture; has its own old-boys rugby club (rcrc.org.nz). Not a recent national Top 4 side.
scenery_notes: Rural Wairarapa campus (Willow Park) near the Tararua Forest Park; wine country (Martinborough), Castlepoint coast; about 1.5 h to Wellington.
notes: All house contacts with emails are on the boarding-houses page. Strong fit for rugby and the outdoors.

alt_email: mcdougalla@pnbhs.school.nz (Andrew McDougall, Assistant College House Manager); admin@pnbhs.school.nz
gap_notes: No gap tutor mention found on the College House pages. Staff include duty staff and an Academic Support role (Shayla Close). Worth a speculative approach.
rugby_notes: Super 8 schools; a leading NZ rugby school. National Top 4 appearances (e.g. 2023); 2025 Hurricanes Top 4 qualifier (played Feilding in the semi) and Super 8 finals host.
scenery_notes: University city on the Manawatū plains; Manawatū Gorge and Te Āpiti wind farm walks, Ruahine and Tararua ranges nearby; 2 h to Ruapehu.
notes: The manager's published email is role-based (chmanager@), not personal. Elite rugby environment.

boarding_houses: L.J. Wild House (separate boys' and girls' hostels)
alt_email: snorman@feildinghigh.school.nz (Sarah Norman, Head of Girls Hostel); vrolls@feildinghigh.school.nz (Vicki Rolls, Matron)
gap_notes: No gap tutor information found on the hostel pages.
rugby_notes: 2025 National Top 4 runner-up (lost the final 43-17 to Rotorua BHS) as Hurricanes/CNI champion; 3rd at the 2024 national Top 4; Hurricanes First XV final winners 2024. Produces All Blacks and Hurricanes players.
scenery_notes: Rural Manawatū farming town beneath the Ruahine Range; 20 min to Palmerston North; about 2 h to the Ruapehu ski fields.
notes: Emails on the source page are Cloudflare-obfuscated; they were decoded from the page itself, not guessed. There is no overall 'Head of Boarding' title, so contact the Head of Boys Hostel. Top-tier rugby.

alt_email: sapatu@hatopaora.school.nz (Sinclair Apatu, Hostel Manager); kfalaoa@hatopaora.school.nz (Kahurangi Falaoa, Tumuaki/Principal); office@hatopaora.school.nz
gap_notes: No gap tutor mention found. Strong Māori and Catholic special character (te reo and tikanga); a cultural-fit statement would help.
rugby_notes: Manawatū Premier 2A schools competition (2025); traditional fixture against Te Aute. Produces professional players (e.g. Nikora Broughton, Otere Black). Also strong kapa haka.
scenery_notes: Rural campus in the Kimbolton Road hill country below the Ruahine Range.
notes: Small school; 'Our People' page lists all hostel staff with emails.

boarding_houses: Bishops, Godwin (girls); Selwyn, Grey, Hadfield, Harvey (boys)
boarders_approx: c.250-280 (CNI Rugby profile: 280 of 430; roll now lower, c.357 in 2026)
alt_email: craig.peebles@collegiate.school.nz (Housemaster Harvey); chris.carey@collegiate.school.nz (Housemaster Hadfield); chris.nevay@collegiate.school.nz (Housemaster Grey); selwyn.hodges@collegiate.school.nz (Housemaster Selwyn); headmaster@collegiate.school.nz (Ainsley Robson, Headmaster & Executive Director of Boarding)
gap_notes: Each house has a resident House Tutor plus evening prep tutors. Round Square member; a gap/residential tutor account from a UK graduate exists. Henry Jones is English (ex-Marlborough College assistant housemaster), which is a good hook for a UK applicant.
rugby_notes: Central North Island (CNI) 1st XV competition; has led the CNI table in recent seasons. Traditional exchange with Hato Pāora.
scenery_notes: Whanganui River (canoe journeys and the Whanganui Journey Great Walk) and west coast beaches; about 1.5 h to the Ruapehu ski fields and Tongariro Crossing.
notes: The most 'English public school' style boarding school in the region. Mr Jones oversees all six houses.

boarding_houses: LAC House (boys' and girls' dormitories; Years 7-13)
gap_notes: LAC House uses 'Volunteer Assistant Deans' who live in the dorms. Historically it takes volunteer student missionaries (e.g. from US Adventist universities). A strong Adventist faith ethos is expected, and Saturday Sabbath would limit weekend rugby.
rugby_notes: Small school; no significant 1st XV profile found.
scenery_notes: Rural Manawatū plains on the edge of Palmerston North.
notes: Older third-party sources name Maria Henry as Director of Boarding, but the 2026 site names Stephanie Ngarepa. No personal email is published, so use boarding@lac.school.nz. Probably a weak fit for a rugby-focused gap year. Also info@lac.school.nz.
